# Ocean Signal

> > Ocean Signal manufactures life-saving maritime safety equipment including EPIRBs, PLBs, AIS beacons, and SART devices for emergency rescue operations worldwide.

Based in Margate, UK, Ocean Signal produces award-winning rescue beacons like the rescueME PLB3 and EPIRB systems that integrate with Cospas-Sarsat satellite networks and AIS technology. The company provides GMDSS-compliant emergency equipment for recreational and commercial maritime use.

## Key Topics

- EPIRB (Emergency Position Indicating Radio Beacon)
- PLB (Personal Locator Beacon)
- AIS (Automatic Identification System)
- Cospas-Sarsat satellite network
- SART (Search and Rescue Transponder)
- GMDSS (Global Maritime Distress and Safety System)
- Man Overboard (MOB) devices
- RescueME product line
- Maritime safety regulations
- Search and rescue operations
- VHF radio communication
- GPS emergency location
- Marine safety equipment
- Beacon registration and maintenance
